meta.name: readme-walkthroughs
meta.description: Produce animated WALKTHROUGH GIFs for the README — never static "hero shot" GIFs. Use this skill whenever the user asks for README demos, product GIFs, demo recordings, "show the feature working", marketing clips of the app, or to refresh/regenerate the walkthrough GIFs after a UI change. It drives the LIVE app with Playwright through a versioned spec, captures clean per-state frames + cursor click targets, and renders a Remotion composition with a gliding cursor, click ripple, step captions, and a progress bar. Also use it when adding a NEW feature that deserves a README demo (add a spec, capture, render, embed).
